Manipulates packages and npx cache

Usage:
npm cache add <package-spec>
npm cache clean [<key>]
npm cache ls [<name>@<version>]
npm cache verify
npm cache npx ls
npm cache npx rm [<key>...]
npm cache npx info <key>...

Options:
[--cache <cache>]

  --cache
    The location of npm's cache directory.


Run "npm help cache" for more info
